method: Relaxation that drops working-time capacities but keeps precedence, calendars and all reservation constraints exactly. Reservation constraints are encoded as disjunctions: COL_FORM_SET (cap 2, 4 unit intervals) holds iff the intervals split into two chains; BEAM_FORM_SET (cap 3) and BEAM_PROP (cap 9, demands 3+3+2+2) hold iff not all four beam intervals share a point, which for intervals means some ordered pair is disjoint; SLAB_PROP (cap 10, 6+6) holds iff the slab intervals are disjoint; SLAB_PANEL_SET (cap 2) never binds. For each choice the earliest-start CPM is the exact relaxed optimum; it is strengthened by preemptive single-resource bounds for activities that use the whole formwork crew, the whole reinforcement crew or the single inspector. The lower bound is the minimum over all choices.
